culprit_citations.quoted_text: Common Shares, par value $0.001 (86,731,536 and 79,355,653 shares issued and outstanding as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, respectively)
Total net assets: 2,157,751 (in thousands) at March 31, 2026
Net asset value per share: $24.88 at March 31, 2026

findings.detail: E04 used the December 31, 2025 share count of 79,355,653 with the March 31, 2026 NAV of $24.88; the current share count is 86,731,536.

rationale: The March 31 balance sheet reports 86,731,536 current shares, $24.88 NAV per share, and $2,157,751 thousand total net assets. The flagged product of $1,974,368,647 equals $24.88 times 79,355,653, which is explicitly the December 31, 2025 comparative share count. Using current shares gives approximately $2,157,480,616; the small difference from total net assets is ordinary NAV-per-share rounding. The flag therefore grounds a comparative-period extraction defect, not an economic inconsistency.
